messages.subject: mosaics ver 1.0.1 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm pleased to announce that mosaics package ver 1.0.1 is released.

mosaics package implements our MOSAiCS model (MOdel based one- and
two- Sample Analysis and i nference for ChIP-Seq) proposed in

Pei Fen Kuan, Dongjun Chung, Guangjin Pan, James A. Thomson, Ron
Stewart, and Sunduz Keles (2011), "A Statistical Framework for the
Analysis of ChIP-Seq Data," To appear in the Journal of the American
Statistical Association.

You can find the latest draft here:

http://works.bepress.com/sunduz_keles/19/

mosaics package is now available at bioconductor (from ver 2.8)
and you can download the package here:

http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/2.8/bioc/html/mosaics.html

The mosaics package companion webpage provides related information.
Please check the following URL.

http://www.stat.wisc.edu/~keles/Software/mosaics/

You can easily learn how to use mosaics package with the vignette:

http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/2.8/bioc/vignettes/mosaics/inst/...

Please leave messages here if you have any questions and comments.

Thanks and hope that you enjoy our mosaics package!

Dongjun
